answers.core: This is about expanding the capabilities of the AnimationBlendSpace nodes with more options that have real applications as nearly all game characters are organic and not robots. It's also a lightweight addition that is in line with existing options.
answers.workaround: No. To be able to use the existing animation tree features, the only option is to use builtin interpolation methods.

title: Add bicubic interpolation BlendMode to AnimationBlendSpace1D and AnimationBlendSpace2D
